acceptance: Every member item of the shallow checkout plan is delivered in sequence.
Checkout step durations are measured before and after, demonstrating reduced overhead.
No required gate, test, or soundness path is compromised.
All changes are reviewed, tested, and landed on develop.
context: Umbrella task for the shallow-clone CI optimization initiative. Coordinates the 6 member items: baseline & inventory -> pilot on tree-only trunk jobs -> test remediation & auxiliary jobs -> test tier rollout -> measurement & closeout.
description: Coordinate the delivery of shallow git checkouts across BenchBox CI workflows (ci.yml, trunk.yml, trunk-coverage.yml, and auxiliary workflows). Replaces fetch-depth: 0 with depth 1 in jobs that require only the checked-out tree, remediates tests that break in shallow clones, preserves full history where ancestry or historical objects are required, and measures checkout time reductions.
